query:
SELECT 
  id,
  client_name,
  client_email,
  total_amount,
  sync_status,
  sync_error,
  asaas_charge_id,
  recorded_at
FROM fuel_records 
WHERE sync_status = 'failed' OR (sync_status = 'pending' AND asaas_charge_id IS NULL)
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC 
LIMIT 10;
